integrity_statement: The asserted theorem has a complete argument and finite independent checks; the computations are corroborative rather than an infinite proof. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A four-run binary linear factor-language theorem; it does not address circular factors, scattered subsequences, or five or more runs. Primary source describes a general enumeration algorithm rather than a stated closed-form four-run classification; independent verification of novelty has not been performed.
title: A three-level minimal-absent-factor law for four-run binary words
